context: Sachiko and Hina enjoy a summer afternoon.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ひなちゃん、夏、本当、暑い、ね。
lines.en: Hina-chan, summer really is hot, isn't it…
lines.style: Soft, unhurried opening. Warm acknowledgment of shared discomfort. Gentle observational tone—the kind of noticing that makes a child feel seen. Slight smile in the voice. No rush to the end.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah, it really is—you get all sweaty.
lines.style: Bright, immediate agreement. High register, quick energy. Genuine delight in conversation—not performing, just naturally enthusiastic. Candid eight-year-old honesty about the sweat.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 優しい、扇風機、本当、いい。
lines.en: A nice fan is really such a good thing, isn't it.
lines.style: Slow, savoring delivery. Warm appreciation threading through each word. The voice of someone remembering comfort, not just naming it. Gentle lift on the observation—sharing gratitude with Hina.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Being together like this is really so much fun.
lines.style: High, clear voice full of genuine joy. Unselfconscious brightness. The naturalness of a child stating something obvious and wonderful at the same time. Soft completion, no trailing fade.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: It really does make me happy, you know.
lines.style: Quiet, tender close. Slower pace than before. The voice of an elder settling into sincerity. Slight catch of affection—almost vulnerable in its directness. Let the emotion live in the silence after.
